neighbours.label: a journal editorial or accompanying commentary ('in an accompanying editorial', 'a set of editorials'; output promotes ' editorial', ' commentary', ' letter')
fire: The paper ran a series of editorials on drug prices.
In an accompanying editorial, the doctors urged caution.
The authors of an accompanying commentary called for more data.
She wrote in an accompanying editorial that the trial was small.
The journal published two editorials on the topic this week.
As one editorial in The Lancet pointed out, costs matter.
In an accompanying perspective article, he raised doubts.
A set of editorials in the journal laid out three goals.
quiet: The paper ran a series of photos on drug prices.
In a separate study, the doctors urged caution.
The authors of a recent survey called for more data.
She wrote in her diary that the trip was short.
The journal published two reviews on the topic this week.
As one nurse in the ward pointed out, costs matter.
In a brief phone call, he raised doubts.
A set of rules in the handbook laid out three goals.

predictions: 5/8 fire; the same frames with a study or letter stay quiet
notes: Output direction promotes ' editorial', ' editor', ' commentary', ' letter', ' opinion'. Card: ' an' x7, ' a' x7, ' accompanying' x2, ' editor' x2. Probe: ' editor' in editorials 0.62; ' accompanying' 0.24-0.26; 'In a recent study' 0.05; 'a letter to her son' 0.04.
